title: Personal Trainer Level 1
subtitle: Become a qualified Personal Trainer. Build real skills. Learn step by step.
description: The foundational course to enter the fitness industry. 12 learning modules, practical resources with gym equipment video library and workout plans, and accredited final exam.
longDescription: A comprehensive learning path designed to master fundamental fitness theory and practice: functional anatomy, exercise physiology, initial assessment, resistance training with machines and free weights, basic sports nutrition, and gym safety. Upon completion and passing the final exam, you will be awarded the National Technical Diploma issued by Libertas (Sports Promotion Body recognized by CONI).
topics: Role and Skills of the Junior Personal Trainer
Functional Anatomy of the Locomotor System
Exercise Physiology and Energy Systems
Initial Assessment and Data Collection
Resistance Machines and Free Weights
Resistance Training Methodology and Load Parameters
Cardiovascular and Metabolic Conditioning
Client Programming and Workout Design
Principles of Nutrition and Body Composition
Training Clients with Different Characteristics
Communication, Coaching and Client Retention
Gym Safety, Injury Prevention and First Aid

title: Personal Trainer Level 2
subtitle: Go beyond the basics. Learn to assess, program and coach at an advanced level.
description: The advanced personal trainer certification. 13 in-depth modules on biomechanics, advanced strength & hypertrophy programming, complex periodization, special populations, and real case studies.
longDescription: A high-level path for trainers seeking mastery. Delves into multi-joint biomechanical analysis, advanced hypertrophy methods (RPE, RIR, velocity-based training), systemic fatigue management, postural observation, and structured program design for complex real-world athlete profiles.
topics: Advanced Functional Anatomy and Myofascial Chains
Advanced Biomechanics and Movement Analysis
Physiology and Chronic Training Adaptations
Advanced Client Assessment and Functional Screening
Advanced Strength and Hypertrophy Programming
Conditioning, Endurance and Energy Systems
Periodization, Fatigue and Load Management
Functional Training and Motor Pattern Integration
Postural Observation and Movement Quality
Training Adaptations for Special Populations
Body Composition and Applied Nutrition
Advanced Coaching and Behaviour Change
Case Studies and Complex Program Design

title: Personal Trainer Level 3
subtitle: Lead, analyse, program and coach at an advanced professional level.
description: The highest-level master course for Head Coaches and Senior Trainers. 10 master modules, 7 case studies, 5 professional documents, project work, and final exam.
longDescription: Tailored for directors of fitness facilities, head coaches, and elite athletic trainers. Covers multi-year periodization, biometric monitoring (HRV, velocity, recovery biomarkers), complex injury prevention, staff leadership, professional ethics, and thesis project presentation.
certification: Master Senior Coach Diploma EPS CONI
topics: Advanced Client / Athlete Assessment and Elite Screening
Applied Advanced Biomechanics and Lever Analysis
Maximal Strength and Power Programming (RFD)
Advanced Hypertrophy: Volume Thresholds (MEV, MRV)
Medium- and Long-Term Periodization Models
Monitoring, Recovery and Fatigue Management
Technology, Data and Professional Documentation
Advanced Coaching, Technical Communication and Leadership
Head Coach: Staff Supervision and Quality Assurance
Professional Ethics, Legal Responsibility and Project Work

title: Calisthenics Level 1
subtitle: Theory, teaching methodology and bodyweight progressions.
description: The official Level 1 Calisthenics Coach course. 13 modules including 178 exercise videos ordered by regression → progression (Push, Pull, Core, Lower Body, Mobility) and final exam.
longDescription: A scientific and practical guide to mastering and coaching bodyweight training. From essential biomechanics and anatomy applied to the bar, rings, and floor, through a comprehensive library of 178 exercise videos organized in instructional regression-to-progression sequences.
topics: Introduction to Calisthenics and Philosophy
Functional Anatomy Applied to Bodyweight Training
Calisthenics Biomechanics: Levers, Moments and Grips
Bodyweight Training Methodology and Volume Parameters
Push Fundamentals: Regressions, Form and Variations
Pull Fundamentals: Horizontal and Vertical Pulling
Core, Stability and Body Control (Hollow, Arch, Plank)
Lower Body in Calisthenics: Squats, Lunges, Pistol prep
Joint Mobility and Tendon Preparation (Wrists, Shoulders)
Calisthenics Programming for Beginners and Intermediates
Teaching Methodology, Manual Spotting and Cueing
Safety, Joint Longevity and Overuse Prevention
Introduction to Basic Skills: Hollow Hold, Dead Hang

title: Calisthenics Level 2
subtitle: Full mastery of skills: prerequisites, regressions and advanced progressions.
description: Dedicated skill-by-skill certification. 20 modules each dedicated to a specific movement (Muscle-Up, Planche, Front Lever, Handstand, HSPU, Dragon Flag, V-Sit, One-Arm Pull-Up) and theoretical-practical exam.
longDescription: A specialized advanced learning path where each major calisthenics skill is structured as an individual module with mobility prerequisites, progressive regressions, technique breakdowns, common fault analysis, and safe spotting protocols for coaches.
access: Unlimited access to all skill paths
topics: Advanced Functional Anatomy Applied to Calisthenics
Skill Biomechanics and Spatial Body Control
Athlete Assessment and Skill Prerequisites
Advanced Training Methodology for Isometric Holds
First Pull-Up and Strict Pulling Mastery
L-Sit: Floor, Parallelettes and Compression Drills
180° Dynamic Bar Rotation
Handstand: Alignment, Shoulder Elevation and Balance
Back Lever: Shoulder Extension and Lever Progressions
Muscle-Up: Explosive Transition and Ring Mechanics
Dragon Flag: Core Rigidity and Eccentric Control
360° Bar Rotation / Swing 360
Handstand Push-Up (HSPU): Wall to Freestanding
Human Flag: Lateral Push-Pull Dynamics
Front Lever: Lats Activation, Hollow and Full Lever
V-Sit: Active Compression and Hamstring Flexibility
Dragon 360: Rotational Flow and Core Power
Planche: Lean, Tuck, Straddle and Full Planche
One-Arm Pull-Up: Asymmetric Loading and Unilateral Pull
Advanced Coaching, Teaching, Spotting and Safety
